name: DARK Utility Cargo Pant
description: The signature DARK wide-leg cargo pant engineered for maximum utility and streetwear edge. Six deep pockets with press-stud flaps, adjustable ankle drawstrings, and a relaxed high-rise waistband. Made from a durable ripstop cotton-poly blend that holds its shape through Kerala's climate. Taped seams and contrast stitching define every panel.
